stem.text: A ball falls through a liquid at a constant speed. It is acted upon by three forces: an upthrust, a drag-force and its weight.

A.text: The drag-force increases with increasing depth.

B.text: The drag-force is equal to the sum of the upthrust and weight.

C.text: The upthrust is constant with increasing depth.

D.text: The weight is greater than the sum of the drag-force and the upthrust.
